Product Details: Introducing MYJAS Exide Battery Water Level Indicator Caps, an essential set of 12 high-grade plastic caps designed specifically for inverter batteries. These innovative caps feature a built-in float mechanism that clearly indicates the battery water level, helping you maintain optimal electrolyte levels. The caps incorporate advanced cooling technology and flame-retardant filters for enhanced safety and performance. Each cap is precisely engineered with a rubber seal to prevent leakage and features upper and lower level markings for accurate monitoring. The durable construction includes a 35mm diameter top section and 15.5mm float stem, ensuring a secure fit on standard battery cells. With these caps installed, you can easily monitor and maintain your battery's water levels, potentially extending battery life through proper maintenance. The set comes with a one-year warranty, demonstrating confidence in the product's durability. These caps are an ideal replacement for standard battery caps, offering both functionality and reliability for your inverter battery maintenance needs.
